generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The new `getResponseMediaType(RestRequest)` overload does not call `checkNonNullMediaType`, unlike the existing `getResponseMediaType(RestRequest, EsqlQueryRequest)` which does. This means the new `EsqlResponseListener(RestChannel, RestRequest)` constructor can leave `this.mediaType` as `null`. Downstream in `buildResponse`, a null `mediaType` will not match any of the format-specific branches (`CSV`, `ArrowFormat`, etc.), which could lead to an unhandled path or a `NullPointerException` when the code attempts to use the media type. Consider calling `checkNonNullMediaType` in the new overload (or in the new constructor) to preserve the invariant that `mediaType` is always non-null after construction.
